grammar.summary: 本课学习表"困境"的结构与过去完成时叙事（救援）。

points.title: 过去完成时 + rescue 叙事
points.explanation: They had been trapped for seventeen hours before help arrived. had been trapped 表受困状态先于救援出现。

examples.en: The men were trapped in the mine.

points.title: keep + 形容词表保持状态
points.explanation: keep calm = 保持冷静，keep + 形容词（keep quiet/keep warm）。

examples.en: They were told to keep calm and wait.
examples.cn: 他们被告知保持冷静等待。
